name: cleanplate
description: Self-hosted asynchronous video watermark detection, multi-ROI inpainting, and automated QA pipeline node built on FastAPI, ComfyUI, and FFmpeg. Automatically detects static or moving overlays without manual masking, chunks long clips into 81-frame windows, executes a multi-model inpainting fallback chain, remuxes audio, and delivers outputs and structured JSON reports via polling or HMAC-SHA256 webhooks.
operatingSystem: Linux / macOS (NVIDIA CUDA GPU required for production AI inference)
applicationSubCategory: Automated video watermark detection and inpainting service
featureList: FFmpeg ingest normalization converting VFR, rotated, odd-dimension, or non-yuv420p inputs to CFR intermediates
Single-pass automatic watermark detection using CPU OpenCV static/persistent-edge detection with ComfyUI native SAM 3.1 fallback
Per-watermark 16px-aligned multi-ROI crop chaining and 81-frame (4k+1) chunk planning
Multi-model inpainting fallback chain (MiniMax-Remover -> DiffuEraser) plus local_fallback for pipeline smoke testing
Automated post-inpaint QA gate checking mask_mean_abs_diff (INPAINT_NO_EFFECT) and residual_overlap (needs_review / QA_RESIDUAL_WATERMARK)
Asynchronous FastAPI job queue with SQLite WAL persistence, Idempotency-Key support, per-tenant rate limiting, and HMAC-SHA256 webhooks
CLI tools for runtime installation, readiness/license auditing (cleanplate-worker --doctor), cleanup, and model scouting (cleanplate-scout)
softwareRequirements: NVIDIA CUDA GPU (~16-24 GB+ VRAM) and ComfyUI v0.38.1 for real AI inpainting
